title: L train: Canarsie Tube closed
report: Signal fire in the Canarsie Tube. No L service between Bedford Av and 8 Av in either direction until further notice.

title: Lexington Ave express suspended
report: Track condition near 14 St-Union Sq. No 4 or 5 trains between Grand Central-42 St and Brooklyn Bridge-City Hall. 6 local trains are running.

title: A and C: Cranberry Street Tunnel closed
report: Water condition in the Cranberry Street Tunnel. No A or C trains between High St and Fulton St.
